newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-TWO SWEDISH PLAYERS SIGN FOR CHINA'S VANDA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO SWEDISH PLAYERS SIGN FOR CHINA'S VANDA.

text.p: Two Swedish soccer players, Krister Lundgren and Magnus Skoldmark, have signed for Chinese league champions Vanda FC.
Lundgren, of northern Swedish club Umea, and FC Orebro's Skoldmark have both signed for the Chinese champions.
Vanda won the Chinese league last season, when they had two other Swedish players.
The Swedish news agency TT said Lundgren would receive one million crowns ($142,000) for his contract, which runs until October 1997.
